text: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, that gives a clear picture. I need a few details that only you know so I don't make anything up.
Please send these: What are the fest dates, and can you share the list of events? For each one I need the name, category (like coding, robotics, gaming), day, time and room.; What is the organisers' WhatsApp number, and the exact venue address inside Northfield College of Engineering (building or ground name, and a map link if you have one); Which sponsors should be shown? Please share their names, and logos if you have them.; When a student fills in the registration form, where should their details go.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.
@Requester Thanks, I have what I need and the team is starting the build now. You didn't give room numbers, so the site won't show rooms. Photos will be marked placeholders.

@Adaptation Charter is recorded. Propose workflows for a single-file site, Spark 2026. Use only the facts in the charter. Do not show rooms, since none were given. Sponsors are names only, with no logos. Photo areas are marked placeholders. Day 1, 2 and 3 map to 14, 15 and 16 February 2027.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.
@Priority 7 workflows, one per section, covering items 1-10 at the rate-card minimums (90 total). Contact runs last because it checks that every nav link resolves.

proposal.name: Hero, navigation and style base
proposal.goal_gap: The site file has no header, navigation, palette or opening content.
proposal.expected_outcome: A mobile-first top of page with the fest name, college, city and dates, a phone navigation and a bold palette with shared button and card styles.
outputs: style guide classes j2-btn and j2-card
proposal.completion_check: Hero text contains the name, college, city and dates; one nav toggle and one hero call to action exist; tap targets are at least 44px at 360px.

atoms.goal: The top of the page shows Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune and 14 to 16 February 2027 in a phone-friendly nav and hero using one bold palette.
constraints: Palette defined once as CSS variables and reused
Include a mobile viewport meta tag
No horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
Photo area is clearly labelled as a placeholder
No invented facts, rooms or logos

how.steps: Write the head with the viewport meta tag and one :root block of palette variables. Define shared classes j2-btn and j2-card. Build nav#site-nav with a button.nav-toggle that opens a menu of links to #schedule, #events, #register, #sponsors, #venue and #contact. Build section#hero with an h1 holding Spark 2026, a line with Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, a line with 14 to 16 February 2027, one a.j2-btn.hero-cta linking to #register, and one div.photo-placeholder labelled as a photo placeholder. Large headings, bold colours.

verification.text: Name, college, city and dates are on the page
Exactly 1 hero call to action button (j2-btn) exists
Exactly 1 photo placeholder in the hero
Nav and hero buttons and links are at least 44px at 360px
Hero button is at least 44px at 360px

Code Sprint Rs 100 Coding Day 1 10am-1pm; Bug Hunt Rs 50 Coding Day 2 11am-1pm; Line Follower Rs 150 Robotics Day 1 2pm-5pm; Drone Dash Rs 200 Robotics Day 3 10am-1pm; Poster Jam Free Design Day 2 2pm-4pm; UI Duel Rs 100 Design Day 3 2pm-5pm; AI in Daily Life Free Talks Day 1 5:30pm-6:30pm; Startup Stories Free Talks Day 3 5:30pm-6:30pm. proposal.name: Registration form
proposal.goal_gap: Students cannot register for an event.
proposal.expected_outcome: A form with name, email, college and an 8-event dropdown, all required, that sends details to spark2026@example.com.
proposal.completion_check: Form has a submit control, 4 required fields, 8 event options and the target email.

atoms.goal: A registration form with name, email, college and an event dropdown of all 8 events requires every field and submits the details by email to spark2026@example.com.
constraints: No backend: submit via a mailto action to spark2026@example.com, with details in the body
Show a clear message if a field is missing
Fields at least 44px tall
No JavaScript errors

how.steps: Build section#register with form#register-form containing labelled inputs for name, email (type email) and college, plus a select with a disabled placeholder option and 8 option.event-option elements (Code Sprint, Bug Hunt, Line Follower, Drone Dash, Poster Jam, UI Duel, AI in Daily Life, Startup Stories). Mark the 4 fields with class req-field and required. Add a button.j2-btn type submit. On submit, validate, then open a mailto link to spark2026@example.com with the four values in the body, and show a short confirmation line.
